title: Theoretical analysis of thermodynamic matrix inversion: first-order equivalence to preconditioned gradient descent and implications for analog computing
task: Thermodynamic matrix inversion via analog computing linked to preconditioned gradient descent

comments: Rigorous bridge between thermodynamic hardware and deterministic optimization; thermal fluctuations shown algorithmically redundant for convex problems, simplifying hardware design considerations.
